summary: Verified duplicate-player (match-wide) and duplicate-champion (team-only) validation across backend (POST+PUT /api/matches) and frontend (/log). All 9 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend /log dropdowns correctly disable already-picked players across the whole match, re-enable on deselect, and disable duplicate champions only within the same team while permitting mirror matchups across opposing teams. EditMatchDialog uses the identical usedPlayers/usedChampsA/B pattern (verified by code inspection).

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — appears to originate from Emergent's dev-mode x-source overlay injecting <span> wrappers inside <option> elements. Not caused by product code; harmless in production builds but worth noting.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1000 lines — consider splitting matches/stats/matchmaking into separate routers for maintainability.
Validation logic is duplicated between create_match and update_match — extract a shared `_validate_match_payload(data)` helper to keep the two endpoints in sync and DRY.

LogMatch.jsx submit guards duplicate the same checks the backend already enforces (good UX) but also duplicate the same literal strings — consider centralising the dup-player/dup-champion messages in a shared constants file.
seed_data_creation: Created up to 4 TEST_DupVal_* players via API for the test module; cleaned up on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend duplicate validation tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_match_validation.py and use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Mirror-champion across teams is explicitly allowed and covered by both the create and update suites.
